summary: Firelookout.ca's Pickle Lake tower has conflicting visitor notes on whether it still stands; a volunteer list names a Pickle Lake Tower removed from Atikokan.

facts.status_note: Disputed. A visitor note on firelookout.ca says it is no longer standing; another says it stands but not at the pinned spot. A volunteer list names a Pickle Lake Tower removed from Atikokan.

evidence.supports: firelookout.ca gives the address as Pickle Lake, Ontario
first note writer says they work out of Pickle Lake
evidence.quote: I work out of Pickle Lake and travel there several times each year.

evidence.supports: visitor note says the tower is definitely no longer standing
evidence.quote: The tower is definitely no longer standing.

evidence.supports: writer says they compared historical maps showing the tower location
evidence.quote: cross referenced some historical maps where the tower location was shown

evidence.supports: writer has worked in Pickle Lake since 2022 without seeing a tower on that spot
evidence.quote: I've been working there since 2022 and never noticed a tower in that spot.

evidence.supports: second note says the tower is still standing but the pinned location is almost certainly wrong
evidence.quote: This tower is still standing but this is almost certainly not the correct location.

evidence.supports: second note places the tower on a ridge near that point; the writer does not know exactly where
evidence.quote: It is on a ridge around this point somewhere, but I don't know where.

evidence.supports: list includes a Pickle Lake Tower removed from Atikokan
evidence.quote: Pickle Lake Tower- Pickle Lake, Ont. (removed from Atikokan, Ont.)

evidence.supports: the list covers towers the MNR considered still standing
evidence.quote: The Ontario MNR has decided, as of 2013, to remove many of these still standing towers.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief's record says sources suggest the tower is gone. The firelookout.ca notes disagree with each other, and the volunteer still-standing list names a Pickle Lake Tower. No source settles whether anything stands today.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only place-specific sources are a firelookout.ca entry with no build, height or type, and two conflicting visitor notes on it, plus one line in a volunteer list. The firelookout.ca pin (51.46783, -90.19378) is the entry's own coordinate and the visitor says it is almost certainly not where the tower stood, so do not treat the pin as the tower site. The 'removed from Atikokan' note suggests a move, but nothing dates it or shows where the tower stands now. No LIO fire-tower record for Pickle Lake was found in the provincial layer. No staffing, build date or access information was found. A 2019 wildfire near Pickle Lake that damaged a CBC transmitter is not about this tower and is not used. A human check of the Atikokan and Pickle Lake records or a local source is the next step.
